title: Header shows customer, vehicle, advisor, lead tech and start date

The work order has a customer, vehicle, service advisor, lead technician and start date set.
steps: Read the header area of the printout.
expected:
1. The header displays: customer name (and company name if present); vehicle year, make, model, VIN, license plate, unit number (if present), mileage, engine hours (if present); service advisor name; lead technician name; and the work order start date.
